GOD CONTINUES TO BE KIND! 🙏❤️
I don’t usually keep a record of everything I have done. I am proud of my journey, but I believe in moving on, staying curious and not taking myself too seriously. There is still so much to do! 😊
But this USA tour of my play #JaanePehchaaneAnjane has made me pause. In city after city, I have received proclamations, commendations and letters whose words have moved me more than I could have imagined. Reading them, I sometimes think, “Have I really done all this?” 🥹🥹
Sometimes, back home, familiarity can mean being taken for granted—even at award functions. So, far away from home, when people acknowledge your work with such love, affection and respect, it touches something deep within you.😍
Above all, it makes me immensely proud to be an Indian actor. To see Indian cinema and theatre celebrated across borders is a joy that goes far beyond any individual honour. 🇮🇳
My heartfelt thanks to Josh Stein, Governor of North Carolina; Janet Cowell, Mayor of Raleigh; and Harold Weinbrecht, Mayor of Cary, for these thoughtful letters and the proclamation. Your recognition of my work in cinema, theatre, education and humanitarian service means a great deal to me. Thank you to everyone who helped make these moments possible.🙏
With a grateful heart, I now look forward to performing Jaane Pehchaane Anjaane in New York tonight! Another stage, another audience, another chance to give my best.
Thank you for the respect. Thank you for the love. Jai Hind! 🙏🇮🇳 @nc_governor @janetrayecowell
